prompt: Recast this first-person account as a neutral incident summary: 'I opened the cupboard and the loose shelf tipped forward. Nothing broke, but three folders fell. I moved the remaining folders to the table and left a note so nobody else would use the cupboard.' Aim for about 80 words.
text: When the cupboard was opened, a loose shelf tipped forward, causing three folders to fall. No items were reported broken. Following the incident, the remaining folders were moved from the cupboard to a table. A note was then left to advise others not to use the cupboard. The account does not indicate why the shelf was loose or whether it was subsequently repaired. The immediate response was limited to relocating the remaining folders and warning other potential users.
